name: Protection Rune

automation.text:
You touch a creature, creating a visible rune etched into its skin. The creature has Resistance to a damage type of your choice.

Use `-choice <damage type>` to specify a resistance.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
